---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new sample, demo, skill, or improvement for this repository
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem or gap is.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when there is no sample showing [...]"

## Describe the Solution You'd Like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen — for example, a new
sample or demo, a new connector example, an additional skill, or an improvement
to an existing one.

## Proposed Area

Where would this fit in the repository?

- [ ] `samples/` (focused product sample)
- [ ] `demos/` (larger end-to-end demonstration)
- [ ] `skills-library/` (Claude Code skill)
- [ ] `extensions/` (custom Flogo extension)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've
considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, references, mockups, or screenshots about the feature
request here.
